answer_length_limit.trigger: In live UI use, 'return me the annual leave policy details' returned 503 twice with error_type=TruncatedCompletion: the reply, including gpt-oss-20b's hidden reasoning, hit the 500-token limit.
changes: LLM_MAX_TOKENS default raised from 500 to 2000 (config.py and .env.example).
TruncatedCompletion is an LLMError subclass that keeps the cut-off call's token usage.
A reply cut off in either call returns kind=too_long with refusal_reason=truncated instead of HTTP 503; the UI shows an 'Answer too long' badge and example questions.
The evaluator counts kind too_long as a refusal; its default --max-cost-usd rose from 0.02 to 0.03 because the worst-case reservation scales with LLM_MAX_TOKENS.
A test checks that .env.example matches the Settings defaults.
answer_length_limit.evaluation_unaffected_because: Neither hosted run had an error, so no reply hit the 500-token limit (largest completions: 404 and 330 tokens), and a higher limit does not change a reply that finished within it. On every saved row the new refusal rule (kind in not_found/too_long) gives the same decision as the old one (answer == NOT_FOUND). Not re-run.

pre_upload_review_fixes.source: Independent read-only code review of the upload copy before publishing.
changes: Evaluator: an embedding failure while ranking a question is recorded in its row, like a generation failure, instead of aborting the paid run.
get_pipeline: requests waiting on a build that fails now fail with it, instead of each running another slow build; a later request still retries.
A failed fallback call is logged with route=conversation, not route=grounded.
The general-knowledge label is recognised when the model formats it (bold, other case) and rewritten exactly; a label with only the not-found text is a decline.
Docs: Node version, image handling, httpx MockTransport, and three stale statements in decision 0002.
frontend/package-lock.json now resolves from registry.npmjs.org instead of a mirror; versions and integrity hashes are unchanged.
pre_upload_review_fixes.evaluation_unaffected_because: Saved hosted rows have only routes grounded and conversation, and every fallback reply in them is the exact not-found text, which the new label handling still declines. The evaluator change only affects runs with an embedding failure; neither saved run had one. Not re-run.

type_check_fixes.trigger: VS Code (Pylance) showed type errors; Pyright 1.1.408 found 42 across app, tests and evals.
changes: openai 3.x is built on httpx2, so the clients take httpx2 clients and catch httpx2 errors; httpx2 is now a direct runtime dependency, httpx (and httpcore, certifi) were removed, and the openai floor is 3.26.1. HTTPS verification uses the OS store via truststore.
Type annotations: chat messages, token usage, a RefusalReason alias, and the evaluator's embedder close; tests use make_settings() and protocol-compatible fakes.
